utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right — the repair drive. I’m a little foggy on the details, but I’m happy to help if you need me to bring anything or spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Oren. Could you help spread the word and maybe bring a few extra tools if you have them?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sure thing — I’ll spread the word and dig around for any extra tools I’ve got. If I forget, just nudge me again.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh—right, the repair drive. What’d I miss?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Nothing major yet—I was just saying we’re still on for the repair drive and I’ll fill you in on the details next.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Got it, thanks. Just point me to the details when you have them.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Did you want me to bring anything for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: No, thank you — just your company is enough.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it — I’ll be there.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, I’m telling everyone about it now — you should come by the repair drive and bring anything that needs a fix!

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’ll stop by—what time and where are you setting it up?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: It’s at the community center parking lot this Saturday from 10 to 2. I’ll save you a spot near the front!

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing, Hana — I’m happy to help with the repair drive. What do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Sam — could you check the repair drive sign-up details first and let me know what items are still needed?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I’ll check the sign-up details and tell you which items are still needed.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can help with the repair drive—what do you need me to bring?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Leo — could you bring your toolbox and a few extra screwdrivers? If you’ve got them, some work gloves would be great too.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sure — I’ll bring my toolbox, extra screwdrivers, and gloves if I find them.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I’m ready to help organize the repair drive and keep things moving smoothly. What do you want me to line up first?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Let’s start with tools and a simple sign-up sheet, then we can fill in the rest as we go.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect — I’ll set up the tool list and a simple sign-up sheet right away, then we can add the rest as folks volunteer.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m happy to help, but I’d want to know the timing and where the drop-off is first.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That’s fair — I’ll get the timing and the drop-off spot sorted, then I’ll let you know right away.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Eli. Just send me the details when you have them, and I’ll plan around it.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — I’m heading out for errands now, so I’ll keep an ear out for any repair drive updates and let you know if I hear anything.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Ira — I really appreciate that. I’ll be here if you hear anything about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Of course — I’ll check in if I hear anything while I’m out.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can keep an eye on what we’ve got and what’s still needed for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, but can you confirm exactly what’s still needed?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I haven’t checked the full list yet, but I can do that and let you know what’s still needed.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I can lend a hand and bring a few tools by for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Gus — that’d be a huge help. I’ll let everyone know you’re bringing tools by.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Glad to help, Jules — I’ll swing by with the tools and see what’s needed.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help coordinate around the school schedule—what time is the repair drive happening?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Thanks, Faye — we’re still locking that in, but I’ll check the schedule and let you know the exact time soon.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Sounds good — just send me the time when you have it, and I’ll work around pickup and after-school commitments.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help line things up around pickup and drop-off times—just tell me when the repair drive needs us.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Faye — that’s really helpful. I’ll send over the repair drive timing as soon as I have it.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Sounds good — once you send it, I’ll work it around school pickup and drop-off.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hi Hana, do you have the repair drive with you today?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Hi Mina — let me check carefully first. I don’t want to say yes unless I’m sure.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So, this repair drive is definitely still happening, right?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yep, still on as far as I’ve heard — people are just pulling things together now. I’ll let you know if I hear any changes.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Good, I just wanted to make sure it wasn’t getting canceled or anything. Let me know if there’s a set time yet.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I’ll get the repair drive organized and keep everyone posted. If you want, I can start by mapping out who needs help first.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: That’d be great, Rosa — I can jot down what supplies we’ve got and what we’re missing.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, Cleo — I’ll line up the neighbors who need the most help first, and you can match that against the supplies list. We’ll have a clear picture in no time.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can help a bit, but I need to keep it low-key right now.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: That works for me — even a quiet hand helps. I’ll keep it simple and low-key.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Leo. I appreciate you keeping it simple — I’ll do what I can without making a fuss.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I heard the repair drive is getting organized, but I’m still waiting on the latest details. If you know what they need, I’d love to hear it.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right — I think they’re still sorting the list, but I’ll ask around and let you know. Sorry, my head’s a bit full these days.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: No worries at all — I appreciate you checking. Just let me know when you hear anything.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good—what do you need from me for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh—right, the repair drive. I’ll check what still needs fixing and let you know what to bring.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great, just send me the list when you have it and I’ll see what I can grab.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hi Sam — I’m here for the repair drive, and I’m happy to help where I can.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hi Mara, great to see you — thanks for helping out. We could use a hand sorting tools and checking the repair list.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely — I can sort the tools and check the repair list. Just point me to where to start.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Gus, I’m putting together a little repair drive and wanted to make sure you’re in the loop—want to help spread the word?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Quinn—I’m happy to help spread the word. Just let me know what you want me to tell folks.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Thanks, Gus! Just tell folks we’re gathering neighbors for a repair drive this Saturday and anyone with a broken item can bring it by.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m late — did I miss anything important about the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Not much yet — we’re still sorting the drop-off spot and the timing for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Good to know — I can help with the drop-off spot or timing if you need an extra hand.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, right — how’s the repair drive going? I’ve been running errands all morning, so I’d love the quick update.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: It’s going well so far—folks have been dropping things off steadily. I’m still keeping track of what’s needed, but it’s coming together.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: That’s great to hear—sounds like it’s really picking up. I’ll keep an eye out while I’m out running errands in case anyone needs anything else.
